import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long[] p = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000};
    static final int M = 998244353;
    static final int M2 = 1000000007;
    static int idx, ans;
    static long n, s[] = new long[10], Idx = -1;
    static int[][] v = new int[10][1000005];
    static int[] L = new int[10];

    static int Del(int x) {
        return x >= M ? x - M : x;
    }

    static int Del1(int x) {
        return x >= M2 ? x - M2 : x;
    }

    static void dfs1(int x, int d) {
        int u = Del(idx - x + M);
        v[d][L[d]++] = u;
        idx++;
        s[d] += u;
        if (d == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            dfs1(x * 10 + i, d + 1);
        }
    }

    static void query(int x, long r) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            long t = (r - x * p[i]) % M;
            if (t < 0) t += M;
            int g = Arrays.binarySearch(v[i], 0, L[i], (int) (M - t));
            if (g < 0) g = -g - 1;
            ans = (int) (Del1(ans + Del((int) ((Idx - x) % M + M))) + s[i] + t * L[i] - 1L * M * (L[i] - g)) % M2;
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(long x) {
        if ((x + 1) * p[6] <= n + 1 && x * p[7] > n) {
            query((int) x, Idx + 1);
            Idx += idx;
            return;
        }
        Idx++;
        ans = Del1(ans + Del((int) ((Idx - x) % M + M)));
        for (int i = (x == 0 ? 0 : 0); i < 10; i++) {
            if (x * 10 + i <= n) {
                dfs2(x * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        dfs1(0, 0);
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        ans = 0;
        dfs2(0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
